// diagnostic

E0509

`{word}` can't leave a `defer` body

What

`{word}` can't leave a `defer` body

Why

A `defer` body runs as its block ends, after the block's own exit was chosen, so it can't choose another.

Fix

Take the `{word}` out of the `defer` body and choose the exit in the block itself.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0509: tests/ui/defer_break.stderr.

Error [jet.DeferLeavesItsBlock]: `break` can't leave a `defer` body

    |             ^^^^^

 Fix: Take the `break` out of the `defer` body and choose the exit in the block itself.
